result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: USD 1M/2M CGL, USD 2M E&O, conditional USD 5M cyber coverage for data processing, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, requiring all coverage for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not necessary. Drafting is also impaired by the duplicate Section 14.10 numbering and placement after the integration clause’s execution language, despite the comment claiming renumbering. The existing bankruptcy and integration terms otherwise remain substantively unchanged.
